questions.text: What precautionary measures should be taken for the conservation of oceans?
questions.text_as_printed: What precautionary measures should be taken for the conservation of oceans? (D)

answer.value:
Ocean Conservation:
Ocean conservation is critical today. Oceans are vital for humans and countless species are becoming polluted.
Preventive measures include transporting crude oil via pipelines instead of ships.
Stop dumping nuclear waste into oceans.
Prevent industrial chemical pollutants from reaching the sea.
Control waste disposal at ports and coastal towns.
Protect coastal sand beaches from degradation.
Create clean, attractive tourist destinations and raise awareness among locals and tourists.
